purpose: Evidence library for resistance-training adaptation estimation. It does not convert training logs directly into true muscle-growth percentages.

principles.rule: Hypertrophy is generally enhanced by higher weekly training volume; ACSM 2026 highlights ~10 sets per muscle group per week as a useful evidence-based reference, not a universal optimum.
principles.engine_use: Reference point for local muscle stimulus; uses a saturating rather than unlimited linear relationship.

source.title: ACSM Position Stand: Resistance Training Prescription for Muscle Function, Hypertrophy, and Physical Performance in Healthy Adults

principles.rule: Meta-analysis supports a graded association between weekly set volume and hypertrophy, with substantial individual variability.
principles.engine_use: More useful weekly sets raise predicted stimulus, with diminishing returns.

source.title: Dose-response relationship between weekly resistance training volume and increases in muscle mass

principles.rule: Hypertrophy tends to improve as sets terminate closer to failure, but the exact dose-response is uncertain and momentary failure is not required.
principles.engine_use: RIR adjusts effective-set quality; the model avoids assigning a magical failure threshold.

source.title: Exploring the Dose-Response Relationship Between Estimated Resistance Training Proximity to Failure, Strength Gain, and Muscle Hypertrophy

principles.rule: Protein supplementation/intake augments resistance-training gains; meta-regression suggests a breakpoint around ~1.6 g/kg/day for fat-free-mass gains in healthy adults.
principles.engine_use: Protein adequacy is treated as a recovery/nutrition environment modifier rather than a direct growth percentage.

source.title: A systematic review, meta-analysis and meta-regression of the effect of protein supplementation on resistance training-induced gains

principles.rule: Severe repeated sleep restriction can reduce myofibrillar protein synthesis; acute sleep deprivation can also lower muscle protein synthesis. These mechanistic findings do not provide a direct long-term hypertrophy conversion factor.
principles.engine_use: Repeated inadequate sleep lowers adaptation confidence/environment; it is never converted into an exact muscle-loss percentage.

source.title: The effect of sleep restriction, with or without high-intensity interval exercise, on myofibrillar protein synthesis

principles.rule: A larger surplus is not clearly better for hypertrophy; faster body-mass gain may primarily increase fat gain.
principles.engine_use: Body-mass trend is used mainly to flag under-fuelling or overly rapid gain, not to award large hypertrophy bonuses.

source.title: Effect of Small and Large Energy Surpluses on Strength, Muscle, and Skinfold Thickness in Resistance-Trained Individuals

principles.rule: Concurrent training can preserve hypertrophy in many contexts, but modality/dose and lower-body strength or muscle-fibre outcomes can show interference; running may be more problematic in some analyses.
principles.engine_use: Running creates only a modest conditional penalty when lower-body resistance load, running load and poor recovery overlap.

source.title: Comparative efficacy of concurrent training types on lower limb strength and muscular hypertrophy

principles.rule: MRI/CT are reference methods; ultrasound is a valid practical method for skeletal-muscle thickness/CSA when measurement technique is standardized.
principles.engine_use: Direct imaging is highest-confidence evidence if user supplies it; circumference is considered an indirect proxy.

source.title: Human skeletal muscle size with ultrasound imaging: a comprehensive review

principles.rule: Muscle-thickness measurement has meaningful absolute error even when relative reliability is high; small changes must be interpreted against repeated-measure error.
principles.engine_use: The app raises confidence only after repeated standardized measurements and sufficient elapsed time.

source.title: Stressing the Relevance of Differentiating between Systematic and Random Measurement Errors in Ultrasound Muscle Thickness Diagnostics

principles.rule: Training studies typically assess hypertrophy across multiple weeks; a 2024 quadriceps ultrasound meta-analysis found significant effects in subgroup analysis after eight weeks.
principles.engine_use: Daily growth is never reported. Confidence rises with 4–8+ weeks of consistent data.

source.title: Effect of resistance training on quadriceps femoris muscle thickness obtained by ultrasound

principles.rule: ACSM 2026 overview of 137 systematic reviews (>30,000 participants): hypertrophy is most consistently enhanced by higher weekly volume; strength favors heavier loads and complete ROM; failure, equipment type and complex periodization are not mandatory for adaptation.
principles.engine_use: Top-level guardrails for exercise selection, volume and progression; prevents novelty/randomness from outranking continuity and dose.

source.title: Resistance Training Prescription for Muscle Function, Hypertrophy, and Physical Performance in Healthy Adults: An Overview of Reviews

principles.rule: Recent meta-regression supports a positive dose-response between weekly resistance-training volume and hypertrophy/strength with diminishing returns; frequency mainly helps distribute productive volume rather than acting as an independent magic variable.
principles.engine_use: Uses ~10 weekly sets per muscle as a reference, a productive floor and a soft upper guardrail instead of unlimited linear volume scoring.

source.title: The Resistance Training Dose Response: Meta-Regressions Exploring the Effects of Weekly Volume and Frequency on Muscle Hypertrophy and Strength Gains

principles.rule: Momentary muscular failure is not required for hypertrophy. Training sufficiently close to failure can be productive while avoiding unnecessary fatigue from forcing every set to failure.
principles.engine_use: Default hypertrophy work is biased toward roughly 1-3 RIR; failure is optional and fatigue-costed.

source.title: Influence of Resistance Training Proximity-to-Failure on Skeletal Muscle Hypertrophy: A Systematic Review with Meta-analysis

principles.rule: Meta-regression indicates muscle hypertrophy tends to improve as sets terminate closer to failure, although the relationship is not precise enough to justify a single mandatory RIR target for all work.
principles.engine_use: Exercise quality score rewards productive proximity-to-failure without demanding 0 RIR.

source.title: Exploring the Dose-Response Relationship Between Estimated Resistance Training Proximity to Failure, Strength Gain, and Muscle Hypertrophy

principles.rule: Hypertrophy can occur across a broad loading range when sets are sufficiently challenging, while higher loads are more specific for maximal strength gains.
principles.engine_use: Keeps hypertrophy exercise choice flexible while prioritizing >=80% 1RM-like loading for maximal-strength objectives.

source.title: Muscle hypertrophy and strength gains after resistance training with different volume-matched loads: a systematic review and meta-analysis

principles.rule: Full ROM generally supports strength and lower-body hypertrophy; long-muscle-length work may offer regional hypertrophy advantages but the magnitude and generalizability remain uncertain.
principles.engine_use: Defaults dynamic hypertrophy movements to controlled full ROM unless skill, pain or anatomy requires another range.

source.title: Effects of range of motion on resistance training adaptations: A systematic review and meta-analysis

principles.rule: When weekly volume is equated, hypertrophy differences between frequencies are small; frequency is best used to distribute volume, manage fatigue and maintain set quality.
principles.engine_use: Prefers repeated exposures when useful but does not score frequency independently of volume and recovery.

source.title: How many times per week should a muscle be trained to maximize muscle hypertrophy?

principles.rule: Periodization can improve maximal strength compared with non-periodized training when volume is equated, especially in trained individuals; hypertrophy differences are less consistent.
principles.engine_use: Uses phases to organize strength/skill emphasis and fatigue, not as a guaranteed hypertrophy multiplier.

source.title: Effects of Periodization on Strength and Muscle Hypertrophy in Volume-Equated Resistance Training Programs

principles.rule: Calisthenics skill and isometric strength are highly task-specific; straight-arm holds and ring skills should be practiced fresh and progressed by quality, leverage, hold time and/or external load rather than by bodybuilding volume alone.
principles.engine_use: Skill elements are ordered before fatigue-heavy hypertrophy work; static quality deterioration stops progression before junk volume accumulates.

source.title: Movement-specific evidence is maintained in movement-science-evidence.json

instructions: Measure at the same anatomical landmark each time.
Use the same time of day and similar hydration/feeding state.
Avoid measuring immediately after training or with a pump.
Keep tape tension consistent and the muscle state consistent (relaxed or flexed).
Take 3 measurements and store the median.
Prefer weekly or biweekly measurements; interpret 4–8 week trends rather than day-to-day change.
Morning, after bathroom, before food/drink when possible.
Use 7-day rolling average rather than a single measurement.
Track load, reps, RIR and static-hold quality.
Improving performance supports adaptation but does not prove local hypertrophy.
Use the same site, posture, device/settings and preferably the same operator.
Avoid post-exercise swelling when comparing scans.

engine.name: Evidence-Weighted Hypertrophy Trend Engine
engine.important: Expected adaptation trend is a decision-support score, not a biological percentage of muscle growth.
engine.heuristic_weights_note: The exact combination weights are engineering heuristics because research does not provide a validated equation that converts sleep, protein, RIR and sets into an individual's percentage muscle growth.
engine.program_continuity_rule: Exercise identity/order stays stable inside the programmed microcycle; daily readiness changes dose before changing exercise identity.
